title: Sigil and Wolf
author: Casper Lockridge
blurb: Marguerite Blackwood, the keeper of a gate that should stay shut, keeps the ledgers of a guild that trades in impossible things. Then the crown announces a hunt for anyone with the gift — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must find the door out of a country that no longer exists, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
